$description: Single source of truth for the Shaheen Money design system: The Feather Line. Edit this file, then run `npm run tokens` to regenerate src/styles/tokens.css. The build fails if any required colour pair misses its contrast threshold, if a forbidden pair starts passing, or if any colour's hue falls in the banned purple band (255-330 degrees).

colorNotes.night: Digital world: hero, why, how, download, footer. Near-black ink with one signal colour.
colorNotes.paper: Physical world: cash-out onward through the blog, and every inner page. Bone paper, ink text, amber for cash.
colorNotes.signal: Dark surfaces only, and sparingly: live motion, the active feather, a changing number, focus. Never above ~3% of a viewport. Fails on paper (1.5:1): use signal-ink there.
colorNotes.amber: Physical cash on dark surfaces (fills, underlines). On paper use amber-ink.
colorNotes.alert: Failure and outage on Night (the operations console: a failed transfer, a service down). error is too dark to read on Night (3.8:1); on Paper the theme's alert is alert-ink, error's hue a step darker so it also reads on raised paper (error itself stays the forms' colour). Always with an icon or a word beside it, never colour alone.
colorNotes.app-*: The Shaheen Money app's own colours, sampled from the owner's screenshots (30 Sep 2026). Only inside UiShard and Device, where the product is shown as it is. The site itself never uses them.
colorNotes.retired: #1400ff (electric blue) is retired from the site: its hue drifts toward violet next to navy.

radiusNotes.sm: Panels, slips, inputs, plates. Hairlines and white space do the work that rounded corners did before.
radiusNotes.full: Pills only: buttons, the language switch, the app's own controls.

shadowNotes.paper: The only shadow in the system, and only under a Slip (a paper document resting on a surface). Everything else is separated by 1px hairlines.

typeNotes.display: Instrument Serif (Latin) and Noto Naskh Arabic 500 (Arabic, chosen by specimen test, docs/DESIGN.md). One italic word per Latin headline; Arabic emphasis is weight, colour or an underline stroke, never italic.
typeNotes.figure: Big statistics and codes are set in Geist Mono with tabular numerals, with the source line in a fixed mono style directly beneath.
typeNotes.label: Mono, uppercase, +0.08em in Latin. In Arabic a label is set in IBM Plex Sans Arabic semibold with no tracking and no case transform (tokens.css handles it).
typeNotes.rtlScale: Noto Naskh sets taller and narrower than Instrument Serif at the same size; Arabic display is scaled down and given a deeper line-height. Arabic body is scaled up.
typeNotes.tracking: Letter-spacing is forced to 0 for Arabic regardless of token (connected script).

motionNotes.names: Draw (hairline stroke), Land (arrive 8-16px + fade), Flip (digital to paper, cash-out and download only), Print (receipt rows), Packet (one 12px signal dash on a route), Temperature (night to paper). See src/lib/motion/.
motionNotes.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion: every scene renders its final state; only 150ms opacity fades remain.
